s194_decision.outcome: EXP-DIET SCREEN WINNER below the chain bar: no record chain; record the measured gain and the per-layer saving
s194_decision.rule: screen winner: min k3x-diet >= 1.005 x every in-load k3x view with every view exact, identical proposals/acceptance, k3x drift <= 0.5 % and a per-layer gate/up saving >= 5 us on both ranks; chain: also min k3x-diet >= 1.02 x every k3x view AND >= 1.02 x 62.345281904743764 = 63.59218754283864 tok/s; D := draft_rows.draft_wall_ms (never op 9); kill rules: inexact, proposals/acceptance differ, k3x drift > 0.5 %, gate/up saving < 5 us per layer (min of rank 0 A/24 and rank 1 B/21, hit means, host-side)

gateup_saving.clock: host-side rank traces and p150 scopes; never a device kernel clock
gateup_saving.price_rule: +1.32 % per 0.01 ms per GDN layer on both ranks (lever synthesis 4), applied to the mean of the two ranks
